ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (~90% dark distribution) with high-intensity highlights localized to scarring and edge water reflections; low global white-to-black ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across the entire visible ventral surface; discrete high-contrast geometric blobs (rosettes) localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 115 degrees and a shallow vertical depth relative to the fluke horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged boundary; pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, appearing as sharp, saw-toothed serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory fitted from the median notch to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; higher density on the leftmost tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches/rake marks) visible on the right lobe, predominantly oriented in a dorsal-ventral direction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch-like indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Almost complete absence of white mottling or pigmentation on the central ventral surface, which is characterized by a nearly uniform low-intensity dark field.
